annotation.title_clean: Outline of "AI Guidelines for Business Ver1.1"
annotation.title_en: Outline of "AI Guidelines for Business Ver1.1"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications; Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (Japan)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Outline slides of Japan's MIC/METI AI Guidelines for Business Ver1.1 (April 2025). It sets ten common guiding principles and role-specific duties for AI developers, providers and business users, using a voluntary, risk-based, living-document approach aligned with international frameworks including the Hiroshima Process. No robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ten common guiding principles: human-centric, safety, fairness, privacy, security, transparency, accountability, education/literacy, fair competition, innovation
Actors split into AI developer, AI provider and AI business user, each with tailored duties
Voluntary, risk-based approach where measures are proportionate to risk
Businesses should build AI governance with management oversight
Additional requirements for advanced AI systems, drawing on the Hiroshima Process Code of Conduct
